stage0008_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「This is B Team, in position.
　Major $$オズマ$$'s C Team is fine too.」

stage0008_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「We're breaching on schedule.
　I'm counting on your backup.」

stage0008_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$甲児$$
「Is $n going to be all right...?
　Assigned to the A Team, going in first...」

stage0008_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$宗介$$ says his field skills are top-notch, but...」

stage0008_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$甲児$$
「But man... he's just some high schooler,
　so where'd he pick that up?」

stage0008_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Who knows...
　Like $$宗介$$, maybe he was a mercenary
　somewhere too, at some point.」

stage0008_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$アルト$$
「He volunteered for the A Team himself.
　And if things go wrong, there's that 《$$ブーストアップ$$》 too.」

stage0008_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「That's enough idle chatter.
　It's almost time for the A Team to breach.」

stage0008_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（If Neo Zeon is really there,
　will my questions finally be answered...）

stage0008_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Really?
　You're not just chickening out, are you?」

stage0008_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$n
「Compared to diving into a 《$$ＤＧ$$》 den,
　this is nothing...」

stage0008_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$クルツ$$
「$$ＤＧ$$...!
　Don't tell me, Dimension Grizzly!?」

stage0008_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$クルツ$$
「For real!?
　You were a 《$$ビーストハンター$$》!?」

stage0008_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$n
「I was just helping my old man out.」

stage0008_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$マオ$$
「I see...
　No wonder you're used to the field, you're a $$ハンター$$.」

stage0008_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「This time, the prey we're hunting
　isn't beasts, it's humans.」

stage0008_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Fitting, from the Echoes commander called Manhunter.
　You've got nerves of steel for jokes.」

stage0008_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「You can call it infamy, if you like.」

stage0008_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Huh? Did that come out sounding snide?」

stage0008_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Heh... don't worry about it.
　I'm used to that kind of talk.」

stage0008_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But whatever they call us, a manhunting unit...
　we have our own pride.」

stage0008_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So even you felt bad
　using our sweet little $$正太郎$$ for a job like this?」

stage0008_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$マオ$$
「Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$, it's nearly time to start the op.
　...So there you have it, $$クルツ$$.
　That's enough chit-chat.」

stage0008_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Heh... I owe you one, Sergeant.
　All right... everyone, prepare to breach!」

stage0008_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「What!?
　That unit just appeared out of nowhere!」

stage0008_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
Branch Member
「Did you see that!?
　This is the Stealth Shadow System we got our hands on!」

stage0008_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
Branch Member
「Now that Lord Branch is gone,
　we haven't dodged $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ for nothing!」

stage0008_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アルト$$
「To think they had gear like that...!」

stage0008_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「They caught us completely off guard!」

stage0008_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$甲児$$
「Sending out that many of them means
　they're going all-out too!」

stage0008_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
Branch Member
「Whoever you are, I don't know,
　but you'll regret coming after us!」

stage0008_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Those guys...!
　Seems they've got nothing to do with Neo Zeon...!」

stage0008_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アルト$$
「Major $$コンロイ$$!
　At this rate, the A Team will...!」

stage0008_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$鉄人$$!
　Is $$正太郎$$ with it!?」

stage0008_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$木下$$
「Please hurry!
　The Robot Mafia is coming!」

stage0008_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$郁絵$$
「Managing Director! We've got everyone aboard!」

stage0008_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
Branch Member
「Damn it!
　We let them get away!」

stage0008_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$正太郎$$... did you see this coming?」

stage0008_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Sorry for being late.
　After you all left, I looked into terrorists
　thought to be lurking around this area, and...」

stage0008_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Then I heard that Robot Mafia survivors
　had stolen the Stealth Shadow System
　from some research lab, and...」

stage0008_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「So just in case, we
　put together a rescue team.」

stage0008_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ワッ太$$!
　Leave this to $$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$...
　get everyone to the Quarter!」

stage0008_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I'll be fine!
　I'll hold out until everyone gets back!」

stage0008_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「I can trust those words, right?」

stage0008_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「...Sorry.
　I'll be counting on you.」

stage0008_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wait for us, $$正太郎$$!
　We'll be right back!」

stage0008_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
Branch Member
「Grr! $$金田正太郎$$, damn you!
　You just won't stop getting in our way!」

stage0008_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That's because you're the ones doing evil!」

stage0008_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Go, $$鉄人$$! $$オックス$$!
　I made a promise to $$ダグザ$$,
　so there's no way we can lose!」

stage0008_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Are you all right, $$正太郎$$!」

stage0008_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Of course!
　$$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$ won't lose to the likes of them!」

stage0008_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$オズマ$$
「That's how it is, Lt. Colonel.
　Both $$正太郎$$ and $$ワッ太$$ are valuable assets to us.」

stage0008_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$マオ$$
「Well then, let's give them a proper thank-you
　for setting us up like that!」

stage0008_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
???
「One who bears the sun detected.
　Commencing attack.」

stage0008_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$甲児$$
「Looks like they're pals with the Robot Mafia!」

stage0008_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$さやか$$
「But that robot and that saucer
　look nothing like the Branch robots...」

stage0008_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$厚井$$
「More than that, it's no Earth-made machine!」

stage0008_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「If that's true, this is a huge deal!」

stage0008_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Captain!
　The Unknowns aren't responding to our hails!」

stage0008_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$オットー$$
「You're telling me they're honest-to-god aliens!?」

stage0008_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$レイアム$$
「What's certain is that they've
　shown hostile intent toward us.
　What are your orders, Captain?」

stage0008_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$オットー$$
「W-we've no choice but to fight back!」

stage0008_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, listen up!
　Since we don't know how the Unknowns will move,
　exercise the utmost caution!」

stage0008_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain...!
　More Unknowns are coming from above!」

stage0008_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Not even an introduction, and you're persistent!」

stage0008_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$マオ$$
「It's fine!
　We've got backup coming too!」

stage0008_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Direct hit on the target.
　Enemy confirmed silenced.」

stage0008_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Well done.
　We'll cover the mobile unit from this position.」

stage0008_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye aye, ma'am.
　I'll pass the word to all hands.」

stage0008_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$マオ$$
「That's our mother ship...
　Attached to $$ミスリル$$'s West Pacific fleet,
　the assault landing submarine $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」

stage0008_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$甲児$$
「Tu... tu... what did you say?」

stage0008_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$n
「$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.
　Named after Celtic mythology, then.」

stage0008_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$さやか$$
「$n, you really know a lot about that stuff.」

stage0008_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$マオ$$
「If you can't remember it, just call it the Danaan.」

stage0008_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Thanks, $$テッサ$$!
　Now the tables have turned!」

stage0008_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$宗介$$
「As expected of the Colonel...
　A precise assist.」

stage0008_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$オットー$$
「So that's the $$ミスリル$$ the commander told us about.」

stage0008_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Just as rumored, their gear seems a decade ahead.」

stage0008_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$オットー$$
「But we're Londo Bell too.
　We can't afford to lose...!」

stage0008_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$オットー$$
「All units, go on the offensive!
　Push them back in one go!」

stage0008_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「The enemy force is wiped out.
　No reinforcements in sight, either.」

stage0008_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Then let's leave the rest to them and pull back.」

stage0008_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$テッサ$$
「After this, we still need to visit that research lab.」

stage0008_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye, ma'am.
　Diving now.」

stage0008_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Huh... not even a goodbye to us?」

stage0008_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$マオ$$
「Can't be helped.
　The fact they sent us on loan to the Quarter
　means the Danaan's got its own op running.」

stage0008_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Since we had the chance, I wanted a good look
　at $$ミスリル$$'s submarine.」

stage0008_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah.
　I've never really seen a submarine up close either.」

stage0008_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That day will come eventually.
　When it does, you're welcome aboard.」

stage0008_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$マオ$$
（And they'll be surprised too,
　when they see our Colonel.）

stage0008_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$オットー$$
「In the end, no leads on Neo Zeon, huh...」

stage0008_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$レイアム$$
「From what we could see,
　the Robot Mafia and the Unknowns
　showed no sign of cooperation.」

stage0008_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$レイアム$$
「For the people of Earth,
　a new invader may have appeared.」

stage0008_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$オットー$$
「The report to headquarters is on you, XO.」

stage0008_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Branch Member, damn you!
　Even with Branch gone, still bent on evil!?」

stage0008_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Go all out, $$鉄人$$!
　We're finishing off the Robot Mafia here!」

stage0008_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$甲児$$
「You're telling me evil aliens showed up again!」

stage0008_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$甲児$$
「But too bad for you!
　As long as Mazinger and I are around,
　don't think you can do as you please on Earth!」

stage0008_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Why is it that so many guys
　who come from space are bad news!」

stage0008_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Get ready, you jerk!
　You're the ones who started this fight,
　so that's why we're fighting back!」

stage0008_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I don't know why you're after $$鉄人$$,
　but if you're attacking Earth, I won't hold back!」

stage0008_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Go, $$鉄人$$!
　Take down the Robot Mafia and the mystery enemy!」

stage0008_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'm used to aliens after the $$再世戦争$$!」

stage0008_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$アルト$$
「Come at me if you dare!
　I'll knock you all out of the sky one by one!」

stage0008_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Whether the enemy is human or not,
　if it obstructs the mission, I will eliminate it.」

stage0008_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$宗介$$
「Whoever's ready to die on Earth, come first...!」

stage0008_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（I couldn't get a read on Neo Zeon's movements...）

stage0008_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（What am I so on edge about...?
　Is it that I'm still afraid
　that person's with Neo Zeon...）

stage0008_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$n
「But that doesn't change that you're my enemy too...!
　Don't think you can get through here!」
